benefits.p: A cover takes the daily wear, spills and sun, so the upholstery underneath stays in better shape.
Well-kept original seats can make your car more attractive when it is time to sell.
Choose wipe-clean PVC or leatherette, or soft fabric: pick the upkeep that suits you.

care.title: Keep your covers looking new
care.subtitle: Simple habits that help each material last longer.
care.note: These are general tips. Always follow any care notes we share with your order.
leather: Wipe dust and spills with a soft, slightly damp cloth.
Use a leather conditioner every few months to keep it supple.
Park in the shade when you can. Strong sun can fade and dry leather.
leatherette: Clean with a damp cloth and a little mild soap.
Avoid harsh solvents and abrasive scrubbers.
Dry spills quickly to keep the surface even.
pvc: Wipe down with mild soapy water, then dry with a soft cloth.
Skip bleach and strong chemical cleaners.
Keep sharp objects off the seats to avoid cuts.
fabric: Vacuum regularly to lift dust and crumbs.
Blot spills straight away instead of rubbing them in.
Spot clean with a fabric cleaner, then let it air dry.

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.subtitle: Can’t find what you need? Ask us on WhatsApp or send a quote request.

items.q: Will the seat covers fit my car?
items.a: Fitment depends on your exact make, model and year. Share these details when you request a quote and we confirm fitment before anything is made. If your model year is not listed, ask us first.

items.q: How do I get a price for my car?
items.a: Every product shows a public list price in INR. For your final price, send a quote request with your car details and choices, and we reply with a quotation for your selection.

items.q: Is a quote request the same as an order?
items.a: No. A quote request is an enquiry. An order exists only after you confirm a quotation we have sent you and we accept it.

Leather gives the most premium look, leatherette offers a leather look in more colours, PVC is the easiest to wipe clean, and fabric is soft and breathable. The materials guide compares them side by side.

items.q: Can I choose my own colour and stitching?
items.a: Yes. Choose from the colours listed on each product, and from its stitching options where they are listed. You can preview colours in the colour studio on this page.

items.q: Will the colour look exactly like it does on screen?
items.a: Colours on screen can differ slightly from the finished product because of screen settings and material batches. Ask us on WhatsApp if you would like more detail before you confirm.

items.q: Can I get my quotation in Hindi?
items.a: Yes. The whole site is available in English and Hindi, and you can choose your preferred language when you request a quote.

items.q: How do I care for my seat covers?
items.a: Most covers need only regular wiping or vacuuming. See the care guide on this page for simple tips for each material.

items.q: What is the quickest way to reach you?
items.a: WhatsApp is the quickest way. Send your car details, and photos of your seats if you have them. For a formal quotation, use the quote request form.

sections.p: Premium Seat Covers makes car seat covers to order. This notice explains what personal information we collect through this website and why.

When you request a quote we collect your name, mobile number with country code, city, car make, model and year, the products and options you choose, an optional message, and whether you agree to marketing messages. We also keep a record of when you gave or withheld that consent. We do not collect payment details on this website.
We use this information to prepare and send you a quotation, to answer questions about your request, and, only if you opt in, to send product updates. We do not sell your information.

If you open a WhatsApp chat from this site, the conversation happens in WhatsApp under its own terms. We contact you on WhatsApp or by phone only for the request you made, or for updates you have agreed to receive.

We keep quote requests for as long as needed to answer them and keep our records. The business owner confirms the exact retention period before launch. You can ask us to delete your request at any time.
You can withdraw marketing consent at any time by messaging us on WhatsApp. Withdrawal takes effect straight away and you will not receive marketing messages after that.
For privacy questions or deletion requests, message us on WhatsApp using the number on the contact page.
This website lets you browse seat covers, see public list prices and request a quotation. Submitting the request does not place an order.
Prices are list prices in Indian rupees and may change. Your final quotation depends on your vehicle, material, colour and quantity, and is confirmed by us in writing.
A quote request is an enquiry. An order exists only after you confirm a quotation we have sent you and we accept it. Until then, nothing is final.
Fitment depends on the exact make, model and year. Confirm fitment with us before you order, especially for model years that are not listed.
Colours and images on screen may differ from the finished product because of screen settings and material batches.
To the extent the law allows, our liability for an accepted order is limited to the price of that order.
We may update these terms. The date at the top of this page shows the latest version.
